Class SingleEngine

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Tile
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Engine
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.SingleEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class SingleEngine extends Engine
Represents a single engine tile in the game. It contributes 1 engine strength and must be oriented SOUTH to be valid.
